title: Nether Water
description: this mod add nether water that can teleport you to the nether
body:
Nether Waters: Precise Portal
Tired of the guesswork when traveling to the Nether? Nether Waters offers a precise and convenient way to reach your exact Nether coordinates. This mod introduces a special water source that acts as a one-way portal directly to the Nether, preserving your exact X, Y, and Z position.

Features:

Precise Nether Teleportation: Step into Nether Water to be instantly transported to the corresponding coordinates in the Nether.
One-Way Portal: For now, this is a one-way trip. Return to the Overworld using traditional Nether portals.
Quick and Easy Nether Access: Save time and effort by bypassing the hassle of building and lighting a Nether portal.
Experience the Nether like never before with Nether Waters. Whether you're building a Nether base or simply exploring, this mod offers a streamlined and efficient way to travel.

Keywords: nether, water, teleport, dimension, portal, precise, coordinates, travel, efficiency
(only obtainable in creative mode)
